Name: Double lane change with prescribed front-wheel steering
Notes: Consumed by double_lane_change.py. An outbound steer/countersteer pair is followed by a straight dwell and the opposite pair to return. Steering_angle_deg is the signed peak FRONT-WHEEL angle in degrees; positive steers left first. This configurable open-loop input uses the rollover_2018.pdf validation measurements, but does not reproduce its Figure 4 waveform or enforce a target lane width.
